MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

4. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
